name: workvivo-mcp
description: Read-only Workvivo access for Claude — your company feed, news, events, people directory, spaces and search through your signed-in session

host.title: Workvivo host
host.description: Your organization's Workvivo host — the address you sign in to, e.g. acme.workvivo.us.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Set to 1 to log verbose request detail to stderr.

tools.name: workvivo_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the fetchproxy bridge, the extension and your Workvivo sign-in end-to-end

tools.name: workvivo_get_feed
tools.description: Read the home feed, a space's feed or a person's posts

tools.name: workvivo_list_news
tools.description: List company news articles — all, one space's, or the featured stories

tools.name: workvivo_get_article
tools.description: Read one news article in full, body as plain text

tools.name: workvivo_get_post
tools.description: Read one post (update) or shoutout (kudos) in full

tools.name: workvivo_list_shoutouts
tools.description: List recent shoutouts — who thanked whom, and why

tools.name: workvivo_get_comments
tools.description: Read the comments on a post, article, event or shoutout, with commenter names

tools.name: workvivo_get_question
tools.description: Read a Q&A question with its answers, votes and the accepted answer

tools.name: workvivo_list_events
tools.description: List upcoming events — times in UTC, location, RSVP state

tools.name: workvivo_get_event
tools.description: Read one event in full (meeting passcodes redacted)

tools.name: workvivo_search_people
tools.description: Search the people directory by name

tools.name: workvivo_get_person
tools.description: Read a colleague's profile — role, manager, bio, expertise

tools.name: workvivo_get_me
tools.description: Read who you are signed in as

tools.name: workvivo_get_my_team
tools.description: List the people on your team

tools.name: workvivo_list_spaces
tools.description: List your spaces, all spaces, trending spaces, or search spaces by name

tools.name: workvivo_list_notifications
tools.description: List your notifications with unread counts (does not mark anything read)

tools.name: workvivo_search
tools.description: Full-text search across articles, posts, events, people, spaces and documents

tools.name: workvivo_api_get
tools.description: GET any other read-only Workvivo API path (credential fields redacted)
